modules.name: resources
modules.responsibility: WebGPU device adapter, 3D texture atlas allocation, buffer pool management, 256-byte bytesPerRow copy layout repacking, and lifetime management.

modules.name: shaders
modules.responsibility: WGSL raymarching volume shaders, transfer function evaluation, non-uniform depth LUT sampling, empty-space skipping, analytical clipping, and GPU picking raycasting.

modules.name: pipeline
modules.responsibility: Render and compute pipeline creation, bind group caching, uniform updates, and frame pass execution.

modules.name: picking
modules.responsibility: Provisional GPU raycast picking pass with 1x1 readback buffer and coordinate/scalar extraction.

r16float.role: Primary scientific scalar volume texture for normalized/unquantized float data. Enables hardware trilinear filtering where supported; manual trilinear interpolation in WGSL provided as universal fallback.

r16uint.role: Quantized 16-bit integer scalar texture ([0, 65534] valid, 65535 reserved missing). Requires manual de-quantization and software trilinear filtering in WGSL.

r8uint.role: Categorical validity mask (1 = valid ocean including 0.0°C, 0 = masked/land). Point-sampled in WGSL for zero-cost empty-space skipping before transfer function evaluation.

copy_alignment_requirements.staging_buffer_repacking_strategy: Dedicated staging repacker copying contiguous brick slices with stride-pitch expansion from 132/66 bytes to 256 bytes per row before GPUQueue.writeTexture / copyBufferToTexture.

wgsl_raymarching_architecture.volume_space: Normalized volume coordinates [u, v, w] in [0, 1]^3
wgsl_raymarching_architecture.aabb_intersection: Smits-Kay ray-AABB slab method returning t_entry and t_exit clipped to camera near plane
wgsl_raymarching_architecture.depth_lut_sampling: Piece-wise continuous interpolation between 31 non-uniform depth levels (0.494m to 453.938m) via 1D LUT storage buffer / texture_1d
wgsl_raymarching_architecture.empty_space_skipping: Point sample validityMaskTexture at current ray sample position; skip transfer function evaluation and ray step advance when mask == 0u

analytical_clipping.evaluation: Discard ray segment outside clipping box during marching or clamp ray entry/exit intervals

gpu_picking_architecture.picking_pass: 1x1 raycasting pass against viewport cursor position (mouseX, mouseY)
gpu_picking_architecture.readback_mechanism: Staging GPUBuffer mapped asynchronously (mapAsync(GPUMapMode.READ)) with immediate unmap
gpu_picking_architecture.reconciliation_flow: Map [normU, normV, normW, scalar] via ProvisionalPickMapper to ProvisionalRenderPickResponse and ReconcilePickRequest for TASK-05 authoritative exact query
